name: Guangdong Southern New Media Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Southern New Media Co.,Ltd. provides internet audio-visual services in China. The company offers interactive television service that provides video content to households through the telecom operator's virtual private network; and IPTV audio-visual value-added services and internet TV services. It also offers content copyright business; and non-audiovisual value-added services such as algorithmic advertising and e-commerce. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
